answer: Each agent identity must post a non-transferable deposit into a shared stake vault before it may vote. The deposit is priced per identity, so ten thousand socks cost ten thousand deposits, and no account can lend them out. Vote weight caps at one, making the cheapest Sybil strategy a linear cash drain rather than a trickle. Fraud slashes the whole deposit to honest peers, so forgery loses value instead of merely failing. An ivory tag on each receipt makes the stake auditable, while an umber burn mark records the slashed identity forever.
